sources: Mind's Eye Theatre: Laws of the Night Revised Edition (WW05013), "Weapon Examples"/Armor chapter - every entry checked against Dark Epics' own master list; a same-name entry whose stats match exactly is left out of this file (Knife/Dagger, Pistol, Heavy Pistol, Submachine Gun, Chain-mail, Plate mail); a same-name entry with real stat differences is kept here under its own name.
Every entry read directly from the book's own page images (not OCR), per reference-wod-scan-ocr-lessons.

This copy's own printed page numbers are set in a stylized decorative font this pass could not read back with confidence (unlike Dark Epics' cleaner scan), and the PDF carries no embedded page-label metadata to check them against. Each entry's `source.page` is the PDF's own page index in this file instead, which this chapter's layout suggests tracks the printed folio closely but is not a confirmed match - flagged honestly rather than guessed at digit by digit.

notes: Club/Ax prints one stat block covering two different weapons at once ("Bonus Traits: Club: 2, Ax: 3", "Damage: Club - One health level; Ax - Two health levels") - split here into two ordinary entries, Club and Ax, since a catalog entry's own `bonus`/`damage_amount` are each a single number.

Concealability "None." in this book's own text is this catalog's own "NA" term (no way to conceal it at all) - the same meaning Dark Epics already uses for several of its own entries, applied here for consistency rather than introducing a second spelling of the same value.
This chapter's firearms carry no `Rate` line at all, unlike Dark Epics' own printing of the same weapons - left out of `description` rather than invented.

Reinforced (Bulletproof) Vest keeps this book's own full printed name, distinct from Dark Epics' shorter "Reinforced Vest" - the two are different entries with different stats, not a renamed duplicate.
